transcript: Fly on over to Regal with me to check out a special screening of the movie. Wicked. Y'all get this. I was invited by Regal themselves to not only come check out the movie, but also to participate in some really cool interactive experiences courtesy of the Regal Prop Shop. We got to pose on a yellow carpet with some proper replicas from the movie. We got to talk to the Wizard of Oz himself, which was so cool. And we even got to virtually try on a costume from the film. They only had Glinda's available, though, so here I am modeling that look. I think I rock. It was truly like a theater kid dream come true. And of course, we had to grab some snacks and merch before it was time to head into the screening and watch the film. We got to watch this film in RPX, which is Regal's, like, top of the line theater, and let me tell you, this is a film that demands to be seen on the largest screen possible. The visuals in this film are just out of this world, from the costume design to the lavish, practical sets. It really is such a feast for the eyes. And the surround sound of the RPX Theater really made the whole thing feel surprisingly immersive. For my full thoughts on the film, I've already posted a non spoiler review which you can check out on my page, but if you can't, Tell, I really loved this movie and if you are a theater fan or a fan of the musical, I cannot recommend enough going to your nearest Regal and checking it out.
